description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Product Engineer based in the United States. 

 The Full Stack Product Engineer will play a key role in designing and building next-generation marketing and growth software, transforming complex technologies into intuitive experiences for non-technical users. You will own product development from concept to deployment, building scalable features and sophisticated frontend systems. Working closely with customers, designers, product managers, and machine learning engineers, you will translate real-world needs into impactful product solutions. You will also integrate advanced machine learning capabilities and analytics into highly interactive user interfaces. This role offers significant technical ownership and autonomy, with opportunities to lead complex projects and influence product direction. Join a fast-paced engineering environment that values innovation, simplicity, high-quality software, and solving challenging problems.



Accountabilities:
 
 Lead end-to-end product engineering initiatives, combining frontend expertise with strong backend capabilities to deliver scalable, intuitive, and reliable software. Collaborate across engineering, product, design, and customer-facing teams to turn complex technical capabilities into practical tools that empower marketing and growth professionals.


 
 Architect, design, and build product features from initial concept through implementation and delivery.



 
 Lead the development and architecture of complex frontend systems, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and excellent user experience.



 
 Build intuitive interfaces that enable non-technical users to access and leverage advanced product capabilities.



 
 Collaborate closely with customers, designers, and product managers to understand user behavior and translate business needs into effective solutions.



 
 Partner with machine learning engineers to integrate advanced models and surface actionable insights through interactive interfaces.



 
 Develop analytics and observability capabilities that help marketing and growth teams understand performance and make informed decisions.



 
 Create user-friendly workflows that enable customers to configure and manage complex marketing experiments.



 
 Design and integrate backend APIs, database models, and supporting infrastructure to deliver complete product experiences.



 
 Take ownership of technical decisions and drive projects independently from architecture through deployment.



 
 Contribute to engineering best practices, maintaining high standards for software quality, scalability, and extensibility.




 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate is an experienced, product-oriented software engineer with a strong full-stack background and a particular strength in frontend architecture. You should have experience building customer-facing SaaS products in high-growth startup environments, combining technical independence with excellent product judgment and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.


 
 At least 5 years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on user-facing and product-centric development.



 
 At least 2 years of experience working at a fast-paced startup, ideally between Series A and Series D, building SaaS products with high engineering standards.



 
 Strong full-stack engineering expertise, including API design, database migrations, frontend development, SQL, and data modeling.



 
 Demonstrated experience independently architecting and building complex frontend systems.



 
 Experience developing CRUD applications and integrating frontend applications with backend APIs.



 
 Proficiency in React and TypeScript.



 
 Familiarity with Go is preferred.



 
 Experience building and delivering customer-facing software products from the ground up.



 
 Strong understanding of frontend architecture, design principles, and scalable software development.



 
 Ability to integrate complex backend functionality and machine learning models into intuitive user interfaces.



 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers and cross-functional teams.



 
 Strong curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a first-principles approach to engineering challenges.



 
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex projects, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with high expectations.



 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or Electrical Engineering from a top-40 university.




 Benefits: 


 
 Competitive annual base salary ranging from $180,000 to $320,000.



 
 Equity compensation through Incentive Stock Options (ISOs).



 
 Fully remote working arrangement within the United States or Canada.



 
 Full-time employment opportunity.



 
 Significant technical ownership and autonomy over projects.



 
 Opportunity to work directly with customers and influence product development.



 
 Exposure to advanced machine learning technologies and innovative marketing and growth products.



 
 Collaborative engineering environment focused on scalable, simple, and extensible software.



 
 Opportunity to work alongside experienced product, design, and machine learning professionals.



 
 Visa transfer support may be available, including H-1B, TN, and O-1 visas.



 
 Work within US time zones.
